title: Greymane Instigator
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Greymane Instigator | image = Greymane Instigator.png | level = 39 - 40 | faction = Combat | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | affiliation = [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] | race = Human | creature = Humanoid | gender = Both | location = [[Gilneas]] | status = Killable }} '''Greymane Instigators''' are humans found along the road to [[Freyshear Keep]] in [[Gilneas]]. ==Quotes== * You won't leave here alive, outsider! * You will find no mercy here, just the wrath of Greymane. * You will die before the might of Gilneas. * I fight for my king, you fight for your life! * In the name of Genn Greymane! * You and the other rebels will be hunted like the cattle you are. * For the Crown! * My sword is stained with the blood of my enemies, and yours will soon join them. ==Abilities== * Demoralizing Shout ==Objective of== * Drops [[Gilnean Blood Vial]] for {{questlong|Horde|43|We Take It From The Living}}. * Drops [[Greymane Signet]] for {{questlong|Horde|45|Greymane Hatred}}. ==Patch changes== * {{Patch|1.17.0|note=Added.}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Gilneas mobs]]
